result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and consistent. The only notable visual defect is the restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel being truncated without an ellipsis or other affordance, which reads as a layout/content clipping issue rather than an intentional design choice.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol' is hard-clipped at the right screen edge with no ellipsis, making the restaurant name unreadable and looking visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) within the card's fixed width, or reduce the card width / add right padding so the title either fits fully or is clearly truncated with an ellipsis.
